manual.logic_unit.line2: {0}With the versatility of {1}Redstone Wires{2} and shunting from {3}Vacuum Tubes{4}, complex redstone can be compacted into {5}Logic Circuits{6}.{7}
manual.logic_unit.line3: The Logic Unit is the specialty machine in which logic circuits are slotted to be used.{0}
manual.logic_unit.line4: It has enough space for a total of §210 circuits§r, and features a full §28 inbuilt registers§r, usable for any circuit.{0}
manual.logic_unit.line5: For a logic unit to interface with the colored redstone systems, it needs to have a {0}Redstone Interface Connector{1} attached to its side.{2}
manual.logic_unit.line6: Every time any of the attached connectors change their state, the logic unit cycles through its circuits and performs all 10 operations.{0}
manual.logic_unit.line7: If a circuit uses a register as an output, the resulting value is kept in the register and may be used by later circuit as an input.{0}
manual.logic_unit.line8: The same interface connector used to input can be used as an output as well.
